summary: Adaptive icon regeneration verified. Config check PASSED: app.json diff is limited to adding android.adaptiveIcon.monochromeImage; `npx expo config --type public` succeeds and prints android.adaptiveIcon = { foregroundImage: './assets/images/adaptive-icon.png', backgroundColor: '#0B3B8F', monochromeImage: './assets/images/adaptive-icon-mono.png' }. FOREGROUND ASSET GEOMETRY: adaptive-icon.png is 1024x1024 RGBA and non-empty, but two minor deviations from the specified safe-zone contract were observed and should be judged by the main agent: (1) content bbox is 305,190 -> 796,670 giving width=491px (spec required >=500px, shortfall 9px, ~1.8%); (2) 48 opaque pixels (alpha>128) lie between r=339 and r=343 from center 512,512, i.e. up to ~5px outside the 66% Android safe circle (r<=338). The content is also visually offset upward (bbox vertical center y=430, 82px above image center 512), which pushes the top corners of the bounding shape past the safe circle. Everything else in the geometry contract holds (RGBA, 1024x1024, non-empty). No file was modified.

issues: Content bbox width is 491px (<500px spec threshold, shortfall of 9px / ~1.8%). Legibility likely still acceptable in practice but does not meet the stated contract.

48 opaque pixels lie outside the 66% Android safe circle (r>338); max distance from center is 342.97px (~5px overflow). Content is vertically offset upward (bbox y range 190-670, midY=430 vs. image center 512), which is what pushes the top corners past the safe circle.

Recommendation: shift content downward by ~82px to re-center vertically, then apply an isotropic downscale of ~0.985x around (512,512). That both moves all opaque pixels inside r<=338 and keeps content width >=500 (would be ~484 after scale; alternatively skip the downscale and only re-center, which alone likely brings max radius to ~318 while keeping width=491, still <500). Cleanest fix: re-center + scale so bbox becomes ~505x494 centered on (512,512), fully inside r=338.
